title: Fantasy Kingdom Map
description: A detailed fantasy map illustration on aged parchment shows a sprawling landscape with snow-capped mountains, a winding river, golden wheat fields, purple flower meadows, dense forests, a circular stone castle, a lakeside town, and a tall dark tower. A flying ship with sails hovers in the cloudy sky above the mountain range.
prompt: highly detailed fantasy map illustration on old parchment paper, aerial view of a medieval kingdom with snow-capped mountains, winding blue river, golden wheat fields, vast purple lavender meadows, dense green forests, circular stone castle with towers, lakeside village, dark gothic tower on a cliff, magical flying ship with sails soaring through clouds in the sky, intricate decorative border, vibrant yet earthy fantasy style
